data.name: Nayem
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawma' which means 'to rest' or 'to sleep'. In the Quran, Allah (SWT) mentions the word 'nayem' in Surah Al-An'am, Ayah 101, when referring to the Day of Judgement and the angels taking the souls of the deceased. Thus, the name Nayem holds a spiritual and profound meaning, symbolizing a peaceful transition from this world to the next.
